fields.engagement: Digital Health Care Wales (DHCW) intends to conduct market engagement with providers who may interested in bidding for the GP Managed Print Service Contract. DHCW has not defined a "route to market" and therefore DHCW welcomes engagement from potential providers. The intention is for DHCW to conduct a market engagement presentation session, with providers who have noted an interest in this Preliminary Market Engagement Notice, in mid June via a digital platform.
fields.submission: Publication date of tender notice (estimated) 14 August 2026
fields.description: General Practice (GP) Managed Print Services. The current fleet is approximately 7,800 devices, the majority of which require a solution based on USB connectivity. Procurement to cover the following themes: - Print Hardware and Installation, - Print Consumables, - Training and Documentation for Practices, - Management of Print Assets and Print Availability (Break/Fix Services), - Provision of Print Activity Reporting and Analytics, including reporting by media type at enterprise, site, and device level, to support operational management, cost transparency, and sustainability objectives
